caseName: Philadelphia & Reading Railway Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Philadelphia & Reading Railway Company, in Error v. United States
summary: In error to the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania.
attorneys: Mr. William Clarke Mason and Mr. Charles Heebner for plaintiff in error., The Solicitor General for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of McLish v. Roff, 141 U. S. 661, 665; Covington v. First National Bank, 185 U. S. 270, 277; Heike v. United States, 217 U. S. 423.
